## Summary

Describe the change and the affected model/backend/API surface.

## Validation

- [ ] CPU build or tests
- [ ] CUDA build or tests, if relevant
- [ ] Python tests, if relevant
- [ ] Correctness or image/video quality check, if generation behavior changed
- [ ] Benchmark numbers, if performance changed

## Notes

Include hardware, model paths in generic form, and any known limitations. Do not
include secrets, private paths, model weights, or generated large artifacts.
